newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 28.

text.p: Four of the Treasury's "wise men" economists will give their verdict on Chancellor Kenneth Clarke's budget to the Commons treasury committee in a session beginning at 1015 GMT on Thursday.

The session with Tim Congdon, Gavyn Davies, Andrew Dilnot and Patrick Minford will be followed by questions in the chamber of the House to Clarke and his fellow Treasury ministers between 1430 and 1515 GMT.
- Statement on future business at 1530 GMT.
- Continuation of the Budget debate after the business statement.
- Cross-party group of MPs sponsor launch of Unilever report by independent academics calling for sustainable fishing. 1100 GMT.
- Labour Party unveils plans for reform of the CAP. Press conference with shadow chancellor Gordon Brown, agriculture spokesman Gavin Strang and Northern Ireland spokeswoman Mo Mowlam. 1000 GMT.
LONDON - Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind speaks to Royal Institute of International Affairs on "Africa: time to take another look", 1330 GMT
